description: How a secret reference maps onto the host's keychain entry and onto the environment variable Hermes reads. One rule, written in Rust (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/secrets/refs.rs) and Python (plugins/hypotaxis/hostsecrets/refs.py); both are tested against these examples.
env_rule: env_prefix + upper(non-alphanumeric runs of '<scope>_<name>' replaced by '_', trimmed) + '_' + first 8 hex digits of sha256(ref), upper-case
builtin_provider_env_note: Built-in Hermes providers have no `providers:` entry and read their key from a variable of their own; setup binds the secret to that variable. The plugin asks Hermes's provider profile instead (forms/effects.py), so this table only needs the providers setup offers.
